remarks: Welcome to this light and bright 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo that offers modern style, comfort, and convenience in one of Wilton's most sought-after communities. This desirable end unit has been completely renovated from top to bottom and is truly move-in ready. The main level features a spacious open-concept living and dining area, filled with natural light- perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The beautifully updated kitchen boasts contemporary finishes and ample cabinetry, with brand new appliances throughout. Completing the main level is a versatile main-floor bedroom and full bath, ideal for guests or a home office, or a main level bedroom! Upstairs, you'll find a private primary suite with a large walk-in closet and a full bath, offering a peaceful retreat. This beautifully updated condo has been redone from top to bottom with premium finishes throughout. Enjoy brand new subfloors with soundproofing, new carpet and tiling, and newly renovated bathrooms with all-new plumbing and fixtures. Features include several new windows, new electric and lighting, new doors, trim, and hardware. Additional upgrades include new dual-zone HVAC, Wi-Fi extenders, and a Lorex doorbell camera. Virtually everything is new- just move right in and enjoy modern comfort and peace of mind.
